input.layout: RGGB mosaic packed into channels [R, G1, G2, B]

scaling.upper_end: not clipped; saturated photosites are exactly 1.0

white_balance.gains: as-shot, normalised to green = 1, stored per patch as [R, G, B]
white_balance.forward: multiply the mosaic by the gains before the network
white_balance.inverse: divide the output by the gains

patches.origin: even pixel offsets, so every patch starts on an R photosite (RGGB phase)
